position_sizing.note: 10% max for new positions, 20% max for existing proven winners. All weights calculated against total capital including cash. min_order_usd: smallest new buy worth placing (a $25 commission on a tiny order is a large % cost). risk_per_trade_pct (L4): new buys are sized so a stop-out loses about this % of total capital, scaled by conviction (High 1.0, Medium 0.75, Low 0.5; x0.75 for a strong bear case), never above max_single_stock_pct.

position_actions.note: The action on a holding is set by these rules, in priority order: SELL (the hard exit or the stop is hit, or Claude says SELL and the thesis tracker rates the thesis BROKEN), TRIM (weight above max_existing_holding_pct, or the stop tracker advises partial profit; amount brings it back to the cap; a Claude SELL on an overweight position with the thesis intact becomes TRIM), WATCH for any other Claude SELL or a broken thesis (review, not a rule exit), TOP-UP (in profit, below top_up_target_pct, Claude's view HOLD or better with Medium/High confidence, cash stays above the floor, RSI within entry_rules.rsi_max, no earnings within the Gate 5 window, sector room, no trade in the stock for top_up_cooldown_days trading days; amount capped by the risk budget and min_order_usd), otherwise HOLD / WATCH. Claude's own label is kept as claude_signal.

rules: Cash below 15% — no new buys under any circumstances, protect the floor
Cash 15-20% — buy only if all 6 quality gates pass, single position only
Cash 20-30% — normal operation, deploy when qualifying picks found
Cash 30-40% — agent should actively seek qualifying picks, flag if none found
Cash above 40% — CAPITAL INEFFICIENCY alert, prioritise deployment into qualifying picks

candidate_universe.note: Normally the candidate list is data/universe_master.json (300 stocks, rebuilt by Refresh Stock List). These sector slots are only used if that file is missing, when Claude proposes a one-off list.

Technology.bias: profitable mega/large-cap, positive FCF, not purely speculative

Healthcare.bias: diversified across pharma, biotech, devices, insurers

Financials.bias: banks, asset managers, payment networks, insurance

Energy.bias: diversified across oil, gas, pipelines, renewables

Utilities.bias: regulated utilities, clean energy, stable dividends

ETFs & Commodities.bias: broad market ETFs, gold, sector ETFs for diversification

pre_filter.note: Applied in Python before Claude sees a candidate: drops beta above max_beta and revenue shrinking faster than min_revenue_growth. RSI is checked later, at Gate 5.

stop_loss.note: Contextual stop replaces fixed %. stop_tracker.py owns all stop logic.
stop_loss.hard_rule: Always exit immediately at -15% cumulative loss — no exceptions, no filters applied

contextual_stop.description: Stop clock only starts when stock decline is stock-specific, not market/sector driven

gate_0a_single_day.description: Single-day loss exceeds 1x ATR — flag for monitoring

filter_1_market.description: If SPY is also down > 1% today, stock decline may be market-driven — suppress stop clock

filter_2_sector.description: If sector ETF is also down > 1% today, decline may be sector rotation — suppress stop clock

stop_clock.description: Clock starts counting days once threshold is breached AND context filters confirm stock-specific decline

level_1.action: ALERT — position under pressure, review thesis

hard_exit.action: EXIT IMMEDIATELY — no clock, no filters

trailing_stop.description: Protect profit without selling on normal noise
trailing_stop.note: Trail stop = highest price since activation minus the wider of min_trail_pct and atr_multiple x the 14-day ATR%. Simulator ledgers start trailing at activate_at_pct; real holdings when the target is confirmed. Tested 2026-11-02, rules review section 10 (was 8% from +10%).

gain_clock.description: Mirror of stop clock for profit target confirmation
gain_clock.note: If price reaches target but reverses, gain clock tracks days above target. After 3 days, take profit or activate trailing stop.

priority_exit_rules.description: Universal rules that trigger priority exit — no stock names
rules: Stop loss breached by more than 2% — exit immediately, no exceptions
Position has lost more than 15% — exit immediately regardless of market context
Position weight exceeds 25% of total capital — trim to below 20% immediately
Holding period exceeds 3 years with no progress toward target — exit and redeploy
Fundamental thesis broken — revenue declining 2+ consecutive quarters, guidance cut

trim_rules.description: Universal rules that trigger a trim — no stock names
rules: Any existing holding exceeds 20% of total capital — trim to 20%
Any new position exceeds 10% of total capital — trim to 10%
Any sector exceeds 30% of total capital — trim highest-weight stock in that sector
RSI above 75 on any holding — consider trimming 25-50% of position

rebalancing.note: Rebalancing triggered by position weight rules — never by stock name.

red_flags: Single new position > 10% of total capital (including cash)
Single existing holding > 20% of total capital (including cash)
Single sector > 30% of total capital (including cash)
Cash below 15% of total capital — hard floor breached
Any position below its contextual stop threshold AND stop clock expired
Any position below -15% cumulative loss — hard exit required immediately
Stop tracker early warning fired — position drifting toward stop
green_flags: RSI below 35 on quality stock — potential entry
Price at or near 200-day MA support
Cash 15-20% — at floor, fully deployed and healthy
Cash above 30% — ready to deploy into qualifying picks
All positions within weight limits — balanced and ready to add
Stop tracker: no positions in warning zone — all holdings healthy

gate1_strategy_score.description: Overall Claude-assessed fit score for the pick (0-100). Must meet or exceed this to qualify. Was hardcoded at 90; relaxed to 81 given how few candidates were clearing 90 in practice.

gate2_risk_level.description: Claude-assessed risk level for the pick. Must be one of these to qualify. Was hardcoded to accept only Low; relaxed to also accept Medium.

gate3_confidence.description: Claude confidence in the pick thesis. Must be one of these to qualify. Was hardcoded to accept only High; relaxed to also accept Medium.

gate4_sector_exposure.description: Pick is rejected if current sector exposure is within this many percentage points of position_sizing.max_sector_pct. Unchanged from the original hardcoded value.

gate5_entry_conditions.description: Pick is rejected if next earnings report is due within this many days. RSI and Fear & Greed thresholds remain under entry_rules. Unchanged from the original hardcoded value.

gate7_headroom.description: Pick must be at least hard_headroom_pct below its 52-week high, OR at least soft_headroom_pct below AND have at least soft_min_upside_pct upside to target. Unchanged from the original hardcoded values.

trading_costs.note: Applied to every buy and sell across all simulator ledgers, matching real-world brokerage commission. Set commission_type to percentage and use commission_pct instead if your broker charges a percentage-of-trade-value fee.

api_budget.note: Claude spend caps. A call is refused (and the run falls back or fails with an alert) if its worst-case cost would exceed either cap. Spend is logged to logs/api_usage.jsonl.

regime_exposure.note: L3: most of total capital allowed in stocks, by regime, cut when VIX is high or breadth narrows. 100 minus this is the cash floor (never below min_cash_pct). When SPY is circuit_breaker_drawdown_pct below its 52-week high, new buys stop unless allow_buying_drawdowns is true.

outcome_grading.note: L2: picks and holdings are graded at 30/60/90 days by rules only — target or stop reached first, otherwise return vs the benchmark over the same days (inside ±band_pct = partially correct). claude_review true adds a Claude second opinion (costs credit), stored beside the rule grade.
